summary: Voyage AI (MongoDB) gives every account its first 200 million tokens free on current text-embedding models (voyage-4-large, voyage-4, voyage-4-lite, voyage-context-4) and rerankers (rerank-3, rerank-3-lite), and 50 million tokens on specialized -2 models (voyage-finance-2, voyage-law-2, voyage-code-2). Multimodal models get 200M text tokens plus 150B pixels free. Free token credits do not apply to Batch API usage, which bills at the discounted batch rate.
claim_steps: Sign up for a Voyage AI account — no credit card required to start.
Create an API key in the dashboard.
Call the embeddings or rerank endpoints; the free token allowance applies automatically per account.
